'''Ben Spax''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had found the Rebellion on his own, and was an able fighter and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. After being screened by the Alliance's [[IntelTech]]s, he had requested a posting in [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Alongside [[Carns Capra]], [[Denis Rygelli]], and [[Trinna Orani]], he was briefed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] on the procedures for establishing a Rebel cell structure on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
